rules.title: Cambridge City Council policy order to ban algorithmic rent-pricing software
rules.requirement: The City Council passed a policy order directing the city manager to draft policy options or ordinance language that would bar residential property management companies from contracting with companies that use algorithmic or AI-driven models to recommend rents. No ordinance has been enacted yet.
rules.coverage_conditions: Would apply to residential property management companies in Cambridge that use third-party algorithmic or AI rent-recommendation services. Final scope is undetermined.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Scope not yet drafted; targets residential property management companies using algorithmic pricing services

rules.citation: Cambridge City Council policy order (no ordinance number given)
rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
rules.conflict_note: This is only a policy order directing staff to draft options; no ordinance has been adopted. The policy order date is not stated (article is circa 2026).
